EBUS.NAME: eBUS
EBUS.DESCRIPTION: eBUS heating bus through a network adapter in raw mode. Reads values only, nothing is written to the devices

IP.DESCRIPTION: IP address of the eBUS network adapter

PORT.DESCRIPTION: TCP port of the adapter in raw mode (every byte of the bus, no enhanced protocol)

MASTER_ADDRESS.NAME: Own master address
MASTER_ADDRESS.DESCRIPTION: Master address used for the read requests, must not be used by another device. 255 (0xFF) has the lowest priority

POLL_INTERVAL.NAME: Poll interval [s]
POLL_INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: How often the registers of the devices are read

DEVICE_ADDRESS.NAME: Device address
DEVICE_ADDRESS.DESCRIPTION: eBUS slave address of the device, 8 (0x08) for the heat pump

CIRCUIT_2_FLOW_TEMPERATURE.NAME: Flow temperature circuit 2 [°C]
CIRCUIT_2_FLOW_TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: Register 15, probably the flow of the mixed circuit (not confirmed)

RUNNING.NAME: Heat pump running
RUNNING.DESCRIPTION: From the operational data the heat pump broadcasts

CIRCULATION_PUMP.NAME: Circulation pump
CIRCULATION_PUMP.DESCRIPTION: From the operational data the heat pump broadcasts

FAULT_CODE.NAME: Fault code
FAULT_CODE.DESCRIPTION: 0 = no fault, broadcast by the heat pump every few minutes

WOLF_REGISTER.NAME: Wolf register
WOLF_REGISTER.DESCRIPTION: Any other register of the device, read only

SCALE.NAME: Scale
SCALE.DESCRIPTION: Value = raw value * scale, e.g. 0.1 for temperatures in 1/10 °C

SIGNED.NAME: Signed
SIGNED.DESCRIPTION: The raw value is a signed 16 bit number
